risks.mitigation: Forbid Intent fields and require Intent Governance as a downstream consumer only.

risks.risk: Context directly accesses or writes Memory
risks.mitigation: Consume only Memory Context Projection Candidates; forbid Raw Memory, database handles, persistence, and mutation.
Preserve possible causes as Unknown or competing source references; Causal Reasoning remains downstream.

risks.risk: Context modifies Reality or Field State
risks.mitigation: Field State Reducer remains the sole Reality-facing writer; Context output is read-only and candidate-only.
Context assembles a bounded envelope only; PCN retains future Connection, Activation, and Context Projection responsibilities.
Keep self_projection and role_projection separate; Role/Social Self remains the Current Role Owner.

risks.risk: Emotion Context becomes Decision influence without governance
risks.mitigation: Accept Emotion Context Candidate references only; forbid emotion calculation, Value rewrite, Decision, and Action.
Apply minimum-sufficient Context complexity policy and require explicit scope reasons.
